Read both. raceView reads only the world and builds fresh arrays and objects. A repo-wide grep for assignments to `world.*` in src finds only `world.tick++` in stepWorld. Bot.input(world) reads but never writes the world.

state() still calls raceView(race.world) fresh, so driver or test code that mutates the returned object cannot poison the cache. The driver only calls game.startRace/step/play/state and never touches the world.
